Sushant Sanjay Kumbhar

Mail ID- sushantkumbhar126@gmail.com Contact- +91 7410753054 LinkedIn- https://www.linkedin.com/in/sushant-kumbhar

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Professional experience of 3 years including 1.10 years of experience as SAP Functional Consultant specializing in EWM implementation and support projects. Skilled in working on S/4HANA and decentralized EWM systems, with expertise in inbound, outbound, internal warehouse processes. Excellent knowledge of supply chain and logistics operations, with emphasis on process improvement and user training.

SKILLS • SAP EWM (S/4HANA 1909, ECC 6.0) • Integration with SAP MM, SD, PP • Business Process Analysis & GAP Identification • Inbound & Outbound Process Configuration • Master Data Management • POSC, LOSC, WOCR, Warehouse Structure • UAT & Functional Specification Documentation • Queue Monitoring, Background Job Scheduling • Open-Source Dashboard Integration • Good knowledge of P2P, O2C cycle and subcontracting process.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Alok Industries Pvt Ltd, Silvassa

Senior Officer – SAP EWM Functional Consultant

July 2023 – Present

Project 1: SAP EWM Implementation & Support

Participated in end-to-end SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) implementations,

supporting solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Conducted unit testing and UAT; ensured solutions met user expectations and business

needs.

Configured warehouse processes and integrated EWM with MM, SD modules. • Developed functional specs, SOPs, and executed master data and bin upload activities. • Worked on CIF functionality for master data transfer.

Provided issue diagnosis and resolution, performing root cause analysis for functional and

integration issues, particularly with SAP ECC.

Contributed to solution improvement initiatives by analyzing existing processes and

proposing enhancements to improve warehouse efficiency and accuracy.

Demonstrated strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills. • Monitored queues and scheduled background jobs for process automation.

Project 2: Job Work Process Implementation

Configured warehouse structure such as warehouse number storage types, storage bins to

facilitate efficient warehouse operations and ensure accurate material storage and retrieval.

Debugged and optimized custom objects for performance and reliability. • • Provided timely support and resolutions to incidents within SLA guidelines. Integrated dashboards for real-time tracking of vehicle movement and warehouse KPIs.

Anuje Industries, Kolhapur

Trainee Mechanical Engineer

June 2021 – August 2022

Supported production and maintenance operations with a focus on efficiency improvement. • Assisted in planning and executing mechanical tasks aligned with engineering standards.

EDUCATION

B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering, D.K.T.E. Society’s Textile & Engineering Institute,

Ichalkaranji (2014 – 2020) | GPA: 68.10%

H.S.C – Science, Sambhajirao Mane High School, Rukadi (2013 – 2014) | GPA: 75.08% • S.S.C Mahatma Gandhi Vidyalaya, Rukadi (2011 – 2012) | GPA: 86.00%

CERTIFICATION SAP Certified Application Associate - Extended Warehouse Management with SAP S/4HANA

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES • SAP ERP ECC 6.0, SAP S/4 HANA 1909 • SAP Modules: EWM, MM, SD • Open-source dashboard integration tools

DECLARATION

I hereby declare that the information provided is true and correct to the best of my knowledge.

Place: Signature: Sushant Sanjay Kumbhar
